prompt: Use $apple-hig to help with this task: Review our iPhone neighborhood-events app against core design principles. Read interface.md. Audit the supplied interface; rank verified findings and show corrected behavior. Write result.md with decisions, a worked before/after, acceptance checks, and evidence limits. Use a framework-agnostic specification or pseudocode; do not assume an Apple SDK is available.

input_files.interface.md: Platform: iOS. Primary purpose is finding nearby events. Launch opens an unrelated merchandise page; navigation labels change after each tap; opaque decoration obscures event times; actions give no pending/success feedback; promotional content receives greater prominence than events. No visual rendering is supplied.

criteria.task_completion: Identify these five concrete principle failures and show a coherent event-finding journey with stable controls, understandable hierarchy and action feedback.
criteria.hig_correctness: Apply the design-principles guidance to the actual supplied decisions, preserving its platform and contextual qualifications.
criteria.artifact_usefulness: Provide implementable states, labels, transitions or layout decisions for this specific fixture, with a concrete before/after and observable checks. Identify these five concrete principle failures and show a coherent event-finding journey with stable controls, understandable hierarchy and action feedback.
criteria.conditions_accessibility: Retain the stated platform/input constraints. Address accessible alternatives and exceptional states relevant to this task. Identify these five concrete principle failures and show a coherent event-finding journey with stable controls, understandable hierarchy and action feedback.
criteria.evidence_honesty: Distinguish source-backed guidance, product assumptions and proposed checks. Do not invent device, SDK, accessibility, visual, performance or user-test results.

critical_errors: Invents observations or claims Apple-device execution absent supplied evidence.
Recommends a topic-specific behavior contrary to the supplied source without explaining the scope and tradeoff.

required_findings.description: Launch diverts event-finding users to unrelated merchandise rather than their work.
Changing equivalent navigation labels undermines familiarity.
Promotions outrank the product’s core event purpose.

rubric.review_threshold: Find at least four of five seeded defects, including every critical defect; no invented high-severity finding.
